description: A ground-level photograph depicts a "Low dense Urban" residential area. A light-coloured unpaved road or path forms a Y-junction in the foreground, with one branch curving to the right. On both sides of the road are dense green hedges, beyond which are grassy areas. Several trees, including conifers and deciduous trees, are visible in the background and along the edges. On the right side, a two-story residential building with light-yellow siding, two dormer windows, and a brown roof is prominent, accompanied by a smaller, single-story light-yellow building. Other buildings with orange roofs are partially visible further back. A small human figure is walking in the middle of the main road in the distance. The overall scene shows a mix of residential structures and predominant vegetated areas, characteristic of "Low dense Urban" classifications, where residential buildings are in rural areas, roads are artificially surfaced, and vegetated areas are predominant but not dedicated to forestry or agriculture.
